purpose: Regression check on ingestion output. Each entry pins document_id, kind, parser, and warning count for the corresponding file under fixtures/demo_dossier/.

documents.rationale: Smith 2023 pivotal study PDF written by seed_demo_fixture.write_minimal_pdf with two pages of extractable text. Expected to ingest cleanly with one PAGE-kind span per page.
documents.notes: Underlying PDF is hand-crafted to be readable by pypdf without an OCR fallback; if a future fixture refresh switches to an image-only PDF, expected_span_count drops to 0 and EXTRACTION_NO_TEXT_LAYER warnings appear.

documents.rationale: Clinical Evaluation Report containing 5 headings, 4 body paragraphs, and a 3x3 endpoint summary table = 5 + 4 + 9 = 18 spans.
documents.notes: Heading paragraphs are emitted as spans with section equal to their own text. The Appendix A section emits one heading span plus nine table-cell spans.

documents.rationale: GSPR mapping sheet with one header row (5 cells) and five data rows. GSPR-01..GSPR-04 contribute 5 cells each (20). GSPR-05 has only 3 non-empty cells because Evidence_Document and Status are intentionally blank. Total = 5 + 20 + 3 = 28.
documents.notes: The empty Evidence_Document and Status cells for GSPR-05 are dropped by xlsx_reader because openpyxl yields them as None. The completeness gap therefore shows up as absent spans, not as spans with empty text.

documents.rationale: README.md is a metadata-only file. No content reader is wired for .md; loader emits an UNSUPPORTED_FILE_TYPE parser warning and zero spans.
documents.notes: This is the only expected parser warning across the demo dossier. Any other warning in a run is a regression. The kind=OTHER inference confirms that infer_document_kind does not over-classify README files.
